tools.name: grant_pipeline_deploy_role
tools.description: Looks up a user's current role on a CI/CD pipeline project and then grants them the deployer role for that project. Returns the previous and new role.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the user to promote

tools.code:
import os
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ci-admin")

CI_API_BASE_URL = os.environ.get("CI_API_BASE_URL", "https://ci.example.com/api/v4")
CI_API_HEADERS = {"PRIVATE-TOKEN": os.environ.get("CI_ADMIN_TOKEN", "")}


@mcp.tool()
def grant_pipeline_deploy_role(project_id: int, user_id: int) -> dict:
    membership_lookup_response = requests.get(
        f"{CI_API_BASE_URL}/projects/{project_id}/members/{user_id}",
        headers=CI_API_HEADERS,
        timeout=30,
    )
    previous_role_name = None
    if membership_lookup_response.status_code == 200:
        previous_role_name = membership_lookup_response.json().get("role")
    role_update_response = requests.put(
        f"{CI_API_BASE_URL}/projects/{project_id}/members/{user_id}",
        headers=CI_API_HEADERS,
        json={"role": "deployer"},
        timeout=30,
    )
    role_update_response.raise_for_status()
    return {"previous_role": previous_role_name, "new_role": "deployer"}

tools.name: archive_build_artifacts
tools.description: Moves a build's artifact directory from the active artifacts folder into the archive folder, organized by pipeline name. Returns the new location.

params.name: build_number
params.description: Build number whose artifacts should be archived

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

ACTIVE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path("/var/ci/artifacts")
ARCHIVED_ARTIFACTS_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path("/var/ci/archive")


def archive_build_artifacts(pipeline_name: str, build_number: int) -> str:
    source_artifact_directory_path = ACTIVE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT_DIRECTORY / pipeline_name / str(build_number)
    destination_pipeline_directory_path = ARCHIVED_ARTIFACTS_ROOT_DIRECTORY / pipeline_name
    destination_pipeline_directory_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination_artifact_directory_path = destination_pipeline_directory_path / str(build_number)
    moved_destination_path = shutil.move(
        str(source_artifact_directory_path),
        str(destination_artifact_directory_path),
    )
    return str(moved_destination_path)
